definition_zh: 文中协调不同离散子结构界面运动和作用的建模方法。
usage_overview: 用于车辆诱发土体振动的子结构建模，通过在近场与远场土体交界处建立协调约束，连接尺寸不同的有限元网格，使两侧子结构共同参与动力分析。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: A substructure coordination method is proposed based on the vehicle–track–soil finite element method (FEM) and differential quadrature finite element method (DQFEM) coupled dynamic model.
These analyses demonstrates that the substructure coordination method for large-scale structures has reached a higher level of maturity.
